Use case: style-transfer. Create a richly detailed architectural environment concept paintover of the supplied actual procedural shop screenshot. Preserve the recognizable footprint, shop identity, eye-height three-quarter frontage camera, depth, and practical circulation. Art direction: classic hand-painted urban background art inspired by the original 1990s Ghost in the Shell and Akira, dense Hong Kong / Kowloon street layers, industrial retrofuturism, intricate but plausible accumulated architecture. Crisp perspective drawing with painterly gouache texture, highly specific construction details, sophisticated muted colors. Strongly cool blue / slate / petrol-blue shadow hue with warm amber and pale old fluorescent practical light pools; readable interior depth, do not crush blacks. Overcast blue-hour ambient street light, not a uniform blue filter. Keep the local warm natural colors of food and wood. More aged industrial detail: exposed cable trays, bundled conduits with real terminations, staggered patched fascia panels, offset steel frames and mounting brackets, old utility boxes, overhead duct elbows and service pipes; additions must look installed over decades. Asymmetric sign and canopy layers, restrained faded red signage, worn green/blue painted metal, water stains and soot localized around joints, grounded clutter. Maintain clear entrance and walkable aisle and all shelves/counters physically supported. No people, no motorbikes, no character art, no giant neon holograms, no purple neon, no explosion or fight. This is a buildable shop concept, not a futuristic skyline. Single full-bleed image, no comparison board, no text annotations.
SHOP: roast-duck restaurant. Retain hanging whole amber roasted ducks inside glass case on right, compact wok/hood kitchen behind counter, small eat-in tables/stools down left wall, clear left entrance and aisle, vintage cream till at payment end. Add a folded rectangular exhaust duct, service riser, small insulated pipe runs, layers of faded Chinese shop signs above awning and restrained warm window lettering. Reinterpret blank upper concrete fascia as visibly patched industrial facade with varied depths and attachments. Blue ambient shadows contrast appetizing amber ducks; deep interior readable. Do not add duplicate sinks or giant kitchen.
